title: What should I do with this?
author: tictactoee
selftext:
It started as a chill mode (free roam), then I had it look at the WR64 decomp. What direction should I take it?

https://clearrunner.vercel.app

comments.author: Savings_Cloud5486
comments.body: could be a great game, is that actual n64 decomp you ported to web ? if does - can you share the pipeline ?

replies.author: tictactoee
replies.body: I first made a jetski sim because I liked someone’s water demo so much. Then I had it run the decomp from github (i provided rom) and it reverse engineered what I wanted it to port on top of my existing “engine” (exact physics, waves, movement, rules etc)

comments.author: SeasawPhilosopher
comments.body: Did you ever play Toad Rash on Sega back in the day. I freaking loved that game. Build a modern version of that on your wave runner engine. Total arcade racing and brawling mayhem.

comments.author: ai_dad_says_hi
comments.body: If just a race/challenge course I think it would get boring. How about like you’re a modern pirate and you’re trying to chase other ships to loot them. Or you’re coast guard and have to head off pirates. Or you’re a lifeguard and you are riding out to save people. Or you’re chasing fast fish to spear them. Or multi-player bumper cars but with jet skis. Or you are pulling a big net end and you have to close it off to catch as many fish as possible
